```{r cars}
counts <- read.csv("dataset_1/count_table.csv", row.names = 1)
counts <- as.matrix(counts)
head(counts)
```
```{r}
# Heatmap of raw similarity
cor_mat <- cor(t(counts), method = "pearson")

heatmap(cor_mat,
        main = "Raw Data Sample Correlation")

```
```{r}
pca <- prcomp(t(counts), scale. = TRUE)

plot(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2],
     main = "PCA - Raw Counts",
     xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2")
```
